features.label: ML inference engine tests

patches.author: Mark Banner
patches.subject: Switch from eslint-plugin-import to eslint-plugin-import-x (comment-only changes for ESLint).

features.summary: The ML inference engine tests now use `eslint-plugin-import-x` instead of `eslint-plugin-import`. This is a tooling-only switch, with no change to how the tests behave.

features.label: Native text generation

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Keep callable alive during TextGeneration callback

features.summary: Native text generation now keeps its callable interface alive while a generation callback is running. This prevents the callback from outliving something it needs, making text generation more reliable.

features.label: ML inference engine tests

patches.author: Mark Banner
patches.subject: Switch from eslint-plugin-import to eslint-plugin-import-x (comment-only changes for ESLint).

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Test native ONNX session memory growth and engine cleanup after initialization failure.

patches.author: Alex G
patches.subject: [Monitor Agent][Models] Preserve the MLPA 429 error code so monitors can tell an exhausted budget from rate limiting

patches.author: Neil Deakin
patches.subject: Bug 2080429, add missing splitContext function,

patches.author: Greg Tatum
patches.subject: Add an owned HiddenFrame for OPFS;

patches.author: Greg Tatum
patches.subject: Add a characterization for OPFS behavior for model downloading;

patches.author: Florian Quèze
patches.subject: Re-enable tests disabled on TSan that pass there on try.

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Make ml.llama.hwInference pref ride the train

features.summary: Work focused on making the ML inference engine and model downloads more reliable: tests now check ONNX session memory use and cleanup after failed startup, and cover how models are downloaded using OPFS, browser storage for files. Monitoring can also distinguish an exhausted ML budget from ordinary rate limiting, while additional tests were restored and a hardware-inference setting now follows Firefox’s regular release schedule.

features.label: ML engine & pipelines

patches.author: Andrea Marchesini
patches.subject: Create an abstraction layer around the auth flow for smartwindow

patches.author: Greg Tatum
patches.subject: Remove OPFS usage in workers;

patches.author: Greg Tatum
patches.subject: Re-work OPFS.sys.mjs to pass TypeScript and remove dead code;

patches.author: Greg Tatum
patches.subject: Remove incorrect isPrivateBrowsing call and test;

features.summary: The ML pipelines’ authentication flow for SmartWindow is now organized behind a shared layer, and OPFS, browser storage for files, is no longer used from workers. The OPFS module was also cleaned up to meet TypeScript checks, and an incorrect private-browsing check was removed—improving maintainability and avoiding misleading privacy behavior.

features.label: Page extractor

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Give monitor checks time to settle before reading pages

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Allow Smart Window to read longer YouTube transcripts

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: clean up outcomes in PageExtractor phase telemetry

features.summary: PageExtractor now waits for page-monitor checks to settle and can read longer YouTube transcripts for Smart Window, helping it capture more complete page content. Its phase telemetry was also cleaned up so the outcomes it records are clearer.

features.label: ML actors

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Release native ONNX inference outputs and metadata. Release engines and workers after initialization failure.

patches.author: Dão Gottwald
patches.subject: Correct the JSDoc types of getInferenceOptions, getAccuracyStats and computeRandScore.

features.summary: The ML actors now release ONNX inference results and their metadata, and clean up inference engines and workers when startup fails. This helps prevent resources from lingering; related API documentation was also corrected for accuracy.

features.label: ML IPC

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Fix --disable-webspeech.

features.summary: The `--disable-webspeech` setting now correctly turns off Web Speech features, such as speech recognition and speech synthesis. This makes the browser’s setting behave as expected when those features need to be disabled.

features.label: ML inference engine docs

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: no bug - docs: use internal references for in-tree docs instead of firefox-source-docs URLs DONTBUILD

features.summary: The ML inference engine documentation now links to other in-tree documentation using internal references instead of external Firefox-source-docs URLs. This keeps documentation links within the project and easier to maintain.

features.label: Native text generation

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Keep callable alive during TextGeneration callback

features.summary: Native text generation now keeps its callable interface alive while a generation callback is running. This prevents the callback from outliving something it needs, making text generation more reliable.

features.label: Page extractor tests

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Let headless extractor tests fire the load deadline after the navigation instead of racing it

features.summary: The headless PageExtractor tests now wait until after navigation before triggering the page-load deadline. This avoids a timing race, making the tests more reliable without changing what users see.

features.label: llama.cpp (vendored)

patches.author: serge-sans-paille
patches.subject: Register SOURCE_HEADERS for third_party/

features.summary: Build configuration was updated to register source headers in the vendored llama.cpp third-party code. This is an internal housekeeping change that helps Firefox account for the bundled library’s source files.
